summary: All reuse hooks named in the architecture spec (F4) and the PR brief exist and were read. One brief inaccuracy corrected: explain.ts `uciToSan` is module-PRIVATE (not exported); F4 reuses the exported `explainPly()` (which calls uciToSan internally) and, for UCI->SAN in the new component, reuses the established ChessGame.moveUci + formatSanLine path that Calculate already uses.

reuseHooks.what: Steps a fresh ChessGame through puzzle.moves at 350ms/ply, reassigning fen + lastMove; builds a numbered SAN line via formatSanLine. NOT exported — logic is inlined in the component. F4 extracts this into a shared component.
reuseHooks.notes: Uses a setTimeout chain stored in revealTimer; cleared on onDestroy. Impure (Date.now indirectly via caller, setTimeout) — playback is a UI concern, kept in the component, not a pure core.

reuseHooks.what: Numbers a SAN ply list into '1.Nf3 e5 2.Bc4'. White-first numbering. Pure. Reusable as-is.
Returns { headline, reasons[], better } — a fact-derived bilingual explanation of one analysed ply. Requires a full PlyAnalysis (engine facts). Pure, locale injected.
reuseHooks.tested: src/analysis/explain.test.ts (10 tests, green incl. fr parity)
reuseHooks.consumerFit: Coach game-review (has PlyAnalysis from runAnalysis). NOT directly usable for a trainer-miss (a puzzle line has no PlyAnalysis / no engine eval at solve time).

reuseHooks.what: UCI->SAN best-effort via chess.js, guarding the promotion field. PRIVATE to explain.ts.
reuseHooks.correction: PR brief lists `uciToSan` as a reuse hook; it is not exported. F4 does NOT export it (avoids widening surface). The shared reveal component derives SAN via new ChessGame(fen).moveUci(uci) + formatSanLine, exactly as Calculate.revealSolution already does.

reuseHooks.what: Inline-SVG clickable win-prob curve with mistake/blunder markers, player vs opponent. No global accuracy grade. Already i18n via t()/fmtPct.
reuseHooks.consumer: Coach game-review (CO13). DEFERRED in F4 to feature PR C6 (see arbitrage Q-C).

reuseHooks.what: winCurve(analysis) -> player-POV win% per ply; criticalMoments(analysis,{max,minLoss}) -> ranked biggest swings (turning points). Pure, deterministic tie-break.
reuseHooks.consumer: Coach game-review turning points (CO13). DEFERRED to C6.

reuseHooks.what: ConceptCard renders title/idea/worked examples. cardForThemes(themes,cards) resolves the highest-precedence card. Already wired behind Tactics `showLearn` (first-exposure OR leech).
reuseHooks.consumer: Already surfaced in Tactics via showLearn. F4 does NOT touch this (arbitrage Q-B: concept card stays behind existing showLearn).

reuseHooks.what: expectedMove() returns next expected user UCI; puzzle.moves is the full verified solution line (user/opp alternating). The trainer marks state.status='failed' on a wrong move; puzzle.moves + puzzle.fen are intact afterwards (the instance is not mutated past the wrong move).
reuseHooks.consumerFit: On a miss, Tactics/Review have puzzle.fen + puzzle.moves in scope -> exactly the inputs Calculate.revealSolution needs. No engine call required (line is pre-verified).

reuseHooks.what: onMove(): on 'wrong' -> stopTimer, feedback=t('tactics.wrong'), finish(false), then RESETS board to puzzle.fen. Solution is NEVER shown. showLearn link (concept card) already present.
onMove(): on 'wrong' -> feedback=t('review.missed'), reset board to puzzle.fen, grade(false). Solution NEVER shown. Same shape as Tactics; second TR1 consumer.
reuseHooks.isProofConsumer: secondary (in-scope to wire as it is structurally identical; see arbitrage Q-C)

reuseHooks.what: Computes full runAnalysis() then DISCARDS the GameAnalysis, keeping only .dimensions for the radar. Result step shows ONLY the Radar. This is CO13: the EvalGraph + turning points are computable but never surfaced.
reuseHooks.consumer: DEFERRED to C6 (arbitrage Q-C). F4 lands the shared component; Coach consumption is C6's job.

reuseHooks.what: Bilingual FR/EN message map. calc.solution already exists ('Solution : {line}' / 'Solution: {line}'). New F4 strings (e.g. a 'Show solution' toggle label, 'why' headers) go here, FR+EN, guarded by translate.test.ts collision test.
Accepts fen, orientation, viewOnly, lastMove, arrows. Calculate drives the reveal purely by reassigning fen + lastMove with viewOnly=true. The shared component reuses the same prop contract.

premiseCorrections: explain.ts uciToSan is NOT exported (brief implied it as a reuse hook) -> reuse explainPly (exported) for the Coach path; derive SAN via ChessGame.moveUci+formatSanLine for the reveal, matching Calculate.

explainPly requires a full PlyAnalysis (engine eval). A trainer-miss has no PlyAnalysis -> the trainer-miss 'why' is the puzzle's THEME-derived line (puzzle.themes -> motif label), NOT explainPly. explainPly is the Coach game-review path (DEFERRED to C6). This splits the 'why' by consumer exactly as arbitrage Q-B recommends.
Two trainer-miss consumers exist (Tactics AND Review), not one. Both have identical miss-reset shape. Q-C revisited: wire BOTH as proof consumers (same one-liner each) rather than Tactics only.
